title: OperatorCandidateSubmissionManifest
description: The candidate-SUBMISSION operator manifest (ADR-069 onboarding / ADR-003) — DISTINCT from the RFC-0005 DISCOVERY manifest served at /.well-known/banza/operator.json (conformance/manifests/schema.json + federation extension). This object is a candidate's onboarding submission descriptor; it is NEVER served at the /.well-known/banza/operator.json discovery route and is NOT the artefact the Open Trust Evaluation fetches (ADR-080). Declares how a candidate operator identifies itself to the BANZA open protocol: its trust key manifest, supported conformance levels, and the operator's own regulatory declaration. SAFETY INVARIANT: 'production_allowed' asserts only that the operator's OWN regulator/authority has authorised the operator — it is validated by that authority, NOT by BANZA. BANZA records the declaration; it never grants, verifies, or substitutes a payment-service authorisation. A manifest never activates a real operator: while state=M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION, 'simulated' is true and 'production_allowed' MUST NOT be relied upon to move funds. BANZA does not process payments, settle value, or move funds.
_authority: ADR-003 (operator separation), ADR-010 (wallet-native identity), Production Protocol Implementation
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

operator_id.description: Stable candidate-operator identifier (e.g. 'operator-a'). Operator-agnostic; never a commercial brand.

environment.description: Non-production environments only at this baseline. A real production environment depends on the first published production conformance evidence and the operator's own regulatory authorisation, both outside this schema.

simulated.description: Always true at M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION. The manifest describes a candidate, not an activated operator.

production_allowed.description: Declarative flag asserting the operator's OWN regulator/authority has authorised it. Validated by that authority, NOT by BANZA. BANZA only records this; it never grants authorisation.

capabilities.description: Protocol surfaces the candidate intends to implement (e.g. 'payment-intents', 'qr', 'federation'). Descriptive, not a grant.

key_manifest_url.description: URL of the operator's key manifest (see key-manifest.production.schema.json). Public keys only.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version the manifest targets (e.g. '1.0.0').

base_url.description: Base URL of the candidate operator implementation.

supported_levels.description: Conformance levels the candidate claims to support (subject to independent conformance review).

operator_regulatory_declaration.description: Operator-owned, declarative/evidential statement of the operator's regulatory posture. BANZA stores it as evidence; BANZA does not verify or issue any licence. Authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

declared_by.description: Operator legal entity making the declaration.

authority.description: Name of the operator's own regulator/supervisory authority (operator's jurisdiction).

status.description: Operator's self-declared status. 'declared_authorised' is an operator claim, not a BANZA verification.

reference.description: Operator-provided reference (licence/registration id) evidencing the declaration. Evidential only.
